description: Groz digital pressure gauge is an ideal solution for measuring air output pressure of filtered air, incombustible & non corrosive gases and can be used with air regulators. It comes with a square body with waterproof rating of IP65 which makes it suitable for outdoor use. It displays air pressure in a choice of 4 units: PSI, BAR, MPa & Kg/cm2 .
